verdict.rationale: Docs detail day-based proration credits (orb-docs-16), pre-save invoice/billing impact previews (orb-docs-11), invoice minimums/maximums (orb-docs-20), and preserved audit trails of every plan assignment (orb-docs-32), directly matching the finance-lead's need for documented, auditable proration math. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that invoice line items reconcile exactly to the penny, and worked examples showing full line-item breakdowns for partial-period charges; community commentary (orb-comm-1) notes MRR/discount-attribution reporting is still challenging, though this doesn't concretely contradict the proration mechanics themselves.
